method: Excel 16 CalculateFullRebuild on temporary workbook copies; macro execution forced off; events disabled; original XLSM files were not modified.
scope: 20 independent raw-input single-slot cases (10 per workbook/profile) plus two commercialModeIndex=2 branch cases from prior verified Excel rebuilds. The engine receives source selector Главная!L11 and independently evaluates CEILING(L11,1) -> Главная!M11 -> L1!D5.
classification: EXACT means engine exact decimal equals Excel COM Value2 decimal text. DISPLAY_MATCH means exact binary/decimal values differ but formatted two-decimal display agrees. No numeric equivalence tolerance is used. Mode-2 legacy records are not independently reclassified where prior engine values were not persisted.
